# AOL

> > AOL is a digital media platform featuring business news, corporate earnings analysis, and market insights across consumer goods, technology, healthcare, and energy sectors.

The site aggregates financial reporting and business analysis from sources like The Motley Fool and Business Wire, covering major corporations including PepsiCo, Walmart, and emerging technology companies. Content focuses on quarterly earnings, market trends, corporate initiatives, and investment analysis.

## Key Topics

- Revenue Growth
- Earnings Analysis
- PepsiCo
- The Motley Fool
- Business Wire
- Beverage Industry
- Snack Business
- Emerging Markets
- Corporate Responsibility
- Market Diversification
- Female-Owned Businesses
- Technology Partnerships
- Healthcare Innovation
- Energy Sector

## Corporate Earnings & Financial Analysis

- [One Year Later: What has changed, and what hasn't](https://www.aol.com/2009/09/15/one-year-later-what-has-changed-and-what-hasnt): Analysis of global economy one year after Lehman Brothers bankruptcy
- [PepsiCo Earnings Preview: On a Quest to Conquer the Snack World](https://www.aol.com/2010/07/19/pepsico-earnings-preview-on-a-profitable-quest-to-conquer-the-s): PepsiCo Q2 earnings preview analyzing snack business and market growth
- [NetSuite Reports Record Revenue for Q4, 2012](https://www.aol.com/2013/01/31/netsuite-reports-record-revenue-for-q4): NetSuite achieves record Q4 2012 revenue with 33% year-over-year growth
- [Don't Get Too Worked Up Over QLogic's Latest Numbers](https://www.aol.com/2013/06/25/dont-get-too-worked-up-over-qlogics-latest-numbers): QLogic financial analysis examining inventory and revenue trends
- [EQT Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend](https://www.aol.com/2012/10/17/eqt-declares-quarterly-cash-dividend): EQT Corporation announces quarterly dividend for shareholders

## Corporate Social Responsibility & Initiatives

- [Walmart Woos Women With Initiatives to Support Female-Owned Businesses](https://www.aol.com/2011/09/14/wal-mart-woos-women-ladies-watch-your-backs): Walmart launches initiatives supporting women workers and female-owned firms
- [Magellan Health Services Establishes National Toll-Free Hotline Following Moore, Oklahoma Tornado](https://www.aol.com/2013/05/21/magellan-health-services-establishes-national-toll): Magellan launches crisis hotline for Moore, Oklahoma tornado victims

## Technology & Innovation

- [Freescale and ROHM Will Collaborate to Deliver Innovative Automotive Solutions for Japanese and Glob](https://www.aol.com/2013/09/11/freescale-and-rohm-will-collaborate-to-deliver-inn): Freescale and ROHM partner on automotive semiconductor solutions
- [Is This Oil Company Pioneering a Carbon Sequestration Movement?](https://www.aol.com/2013/05/20/is-this-oil-company-pioneering-a-carbon-sequestrat): Denbury Resources explores CO2 sequestration for oil recovery

## Healthcare & Medical Technology

- [A Hidden Reason Nxstage Medical's Future Looks Bright](https://www.aol.com/2012/05/24/a-hidden-reason-nxstage-medicals-future-looks-bri): Motley Fool analysis of Nxstage Medical inventory levels and prospects
